name: move_to
description:
Move selected TCPs to world-frame positions while holding each measured action-start orientation.
Use when: the intended change is translation-only repositioning in free space.
Effect: world mutation; compiles to move_pose with interaction=free_space, so a target more than a few centimetres away horizontally is reached by lifting, traversing and descending, and every planned tick is checked before anything moves.
Returns: an immediate acknowledgement with status=submitted, action and compiled_pose; compiled_pose.targets is the requested target, not a measured arrival. The later receipt and fresh observation report the plan, execution status and measured pose.
Does not: rotate, command a gripper, steer around objects on the table, or guarantee reachability.
On error: read failure_stage and failure_code as for move_pose, then choose a reachable intermediate or recover_pose. Numerical inputs follow compute's Use when rule; send every value in this tool's declared units and frame.

targets.description: Non-empty translation-only targets over left and right. Omitted arms are not commanded; use move_pose first when an orientation must change.

left.description: The left arm's translation-only target; use it once that arm's current orientation is already suitable. Null means omitted.

position_m.description: Absolute world-frame [x,y,z] left TCP position in metres. The action-start orientation is held: decreasing world z lowers the TCP but does not pitch the gripper.

right.description: The right arm's translation-only target; use it once that arm's current orientation is already suitable. Null means omitted.

position_m.description: Absolute world-frame [x,y,z] right TCP position in metres. The action-start orientation is held: decreasing world z lowers the TCP but does not pitch the gripper.
